routing_policy: An explicitly named skill wins over fuzzy matching.
Otherwise route only when one skill is a clear semantic match.
If no skill matches or multiple skills are equally plausible, ask a focused clarification question.
Use multiple skills only when the user requests combined work or the requested tasks are clearly independent.
Read this compact catalog first; load only the selected skill's SKILL.md and its referenced material.
